objective_for_doctor: A 57-year-old F patient presents to the clinic. Chief complaint: loss of appetite.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had a loss of appetite, and I’ve also had a cough with nasal congestion or a clear runny nose, along with fever, chills or shivers.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—since you mentioned loss of appetite plus cough, runny nose/congestion, fever and chills, how many days has this been going on and how high has your fever been?  
Doctor: Do you have shortness of breath, chest pain, sore throat, or any known COVID/flu exposure?
I don’t know.

Doctor: I’m going to ask a few quick questions—do you have any shortness of breath or chest pain right now, and is your cough dry or producing mucus/phlegm (what color)?  
Doctor: Also, have you noticed weight loss beyond this illness, night sweats, or any blood in your sputum?

I don’t know.

I have had significantly increased sweating, and I’ve had chills or shivers, but I don’t know about weight loss, night sweats, or blood in my sputum.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—when you cough, do you produce any phlegm (even a little), and if so what color (clear/white/yellow-green/bloody) and about how many days has this whole illness lasted?  
Doctor: Also, any known medical conditions (diabetes, COPD/asthma), smoking history, or are you able to check your temperature now?

I don’t know about whether I produce any phlegm or what color it would be. I also don’t know about how many days this whole illness has lasted.

I do smoke cigarettes. I don’t know about any other medical conditions.

Doctor: Since you’re not sure about the phlegm color/duration, can you tell me: roughly how old are you (confirm 57), and are you currently having fever (do you have a thermometer reading), or is it “feels feverish” only?  
Doctor: Also, on a scale of 0–10, how severe is the cough, and have you noticed any unintentional weight loss or night sweats even if the illness has changed?  
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray  
REQUEST TEST: COVID_Influenza_Test

I’m 57. I don’t know about whether I currently have a thermometer reading, but I have had a fever (either felt or measured with a thermometer). I also have significantly increased sweating and chills or shivers.

I don’t know the cough severity on a 0–10 scale. I don’t know about any unintentional weight loss or night sweats beyond this illness.

Doctor: Also, do you feel any chest pain when you breathe in or cough?
I don’t know.

Doctor: I’m Dr. Agent—since you’re not sure about duration, do you at least remember whether it started suddenly (within 1 day) or gradually (over several days)?

I don’t know.

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

I don’t know. I also have a cough, but I don’t know whether it’s dry or producing mucus/phlegm or what color it would be.

I don’t know.
